name: Trap!
source:
Dartmoor, England...
-- A land of misty desolate moors, towering craggy tors, ancient weathered standing stones -- and Faeries. It's a place where things aren't always what they seem. Or where they seem.

Will you escape to tell the tale?
-- Or fall into the Trap!

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=24481]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
